title: Reconcile webhooks against the logs api
summary: A pass over a time window of the voice and message logs finds the calls and messages your webhook handler never recorded, and fetches the event trail of each missed call.
scenario: A nightly job that catches the status callbacks a deploy swallowed

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json GET /api/voice/logs and /api/messaging/logs: created_after, created_before, page_size 1-1000; GET /api/voice/logs/{id}/events -> Voice.LogEvent{event_at, level, name, details}
